text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer, good day to you~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They were helping me make clothes for 
Rice's plushies... but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Good ideas for clothing designs just 
aren't coming to me easily~. That is why 
I'm going for a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The academy is just brimming with 
excitement. Fresh ideas keep popping up! 
Would you care to join me, Trainer?

Since I was invited, I decided to take a 
walk around the academy grounds with the 
two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now then, first we have this~.
choice_data_list: Is it really okay to just walk in here...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"In exchange for helping with research, 
you may watch if you so desire"... is what 
Tachyon-sama graciously told me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This place truly stirs the imagination～. 
A dark laboratory as a deep forest, 
chemicals in flasks like strangely glowing 
mushrooms――

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it really is...! In that case, puffy 
smoke can be clouds...
(DOOOONG!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This way next~ We're going to get in touch 
with the academy's nature~

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Bright-san... shouldn't we stop 
already...? Earlier, I'm pretty sure you 
just got wrapped up in Rice's 
misfortune...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~ It led to a wonderful flash of 
inspiration♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us continue to enjoy what comes 
next. Let's go~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Here we are~.
choice_data_list: Was there always a place like this here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice didn't know either... But it kind of 
feels like the place Rice imagined 
earlier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~, how about it? Look very closely... 
Can you see what you want to make?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's dark, but so sparkly, and with 
flowers... Rice thinks she just got an 
idea for an outfit to make...!

And so, having finally gotten a clear 
vision for the outfit, we reached the 
production phase, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, one more time. Carefully stitch it 
from the beginning...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's no good. One more time...!

Rice Shower has been stitching and 
unraveling her work repeatedly for a while 
now. She seems anxious about something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what seems to be the matter? It 
looked like you were on the verge of 
finishing with the previous one, though~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Bright-san helped me so much with 
brainstorming ideas and making the 
patterns, so I really want to make it 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So whenever I find a flaw, it really 
bothers me... and I feel like I have to 
fix it. Um, I'm sorry for taking so 
long...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, I will gladly keep you company 
as long as you'd like. However, let me 
see~... Would you care to try a little 
"good luck charm" with me~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Stitch by stitch, carefully does it. 
Whispering, "May you turn out lovely"... 
Come now, altogether~♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...A good-luck charm.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I'll cast a spell... to make it 
cute and pretty...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Stitch by stitch... "May you turn out 
cute. May you become a wonderful 
outfit...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's done, it's really done...! Like 
fairies playing in a forest at night— I 
made an outfit just like I imagined...!

After casting the charm— the work that had 
been stalling so badly proceeded with 
astonishing smoothness...!
choice_data_list: Bright's charm is amazing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, not at all. I merely gave a little 
push from behind at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
When Lady Rice spoke to me, saying, "I 
want to make cute clothes"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I knew ever since then that you would 
surely be able to do it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Once you take the first step, all that's 
left is to keep walking. And if you 
hesitate on the next step, all I have to 
do is give you a push—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's slow, even if you lack 
confidence, even if you lose your way. As 
long as you keep walking, you will reach 
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Taking it one step at a time toward our 
goal—it was another truly wonderful time 
together, wasn't it?♪

An unwavering belief that it can be done, 
and the strength to keep moving 
forward—with this power, she seemed to 
have been guiding everything from the 
start.
choice_data_list:
You also need the stamina to keep moving 
forward.

You also need the stamina to keep moving 
forward, you know.
So that's the secret to success!
So that's the secret to success!

text_block_list.text:

and the strength to keep moving 
forward—with this power, she seemed to 
have been guiding everything from the 
start.
choice_data_list:
You also need the stamina to keep moving 
forward.

forward, you know.
So that's the secret to success!
So that's the secret to success!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed~. However, I am not worried about 
that at all~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
After all, it is my forte. Long, grueling 
battles of endurance, that is.

Though spoken in a calm and gentle tone, 
there was an unmistakable sense of power 
and resilience behind her words...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Thank you so much...! Do you have 
any other secrets? Rice wants to learn 
from your example, too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My~, ufufu! To be spoken of so highly by 
the two of you is truly an honor♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is true~... ...Getting plenty of 
sleep always revitalizes you~♪

Mejiro Bright smiled as she made her 
airheaded comment. Yet her talent for 
steady, diligent effort was the real deal. 
It was a moment that made me want to learn 
from her mindset.
